Arrival checks, hardworking and clear
It explains what happens at the desk for people travelling soon
Companion Animal Travel Desk: arrival checks for companion animals

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the process steady and simple. When you arrive, the team checks the travel paperwork, looks over the booking details, and makes sure the animal's comfort needs are understood before the trip moves forward. The aim is to keep the handoff calm for both traveler and pet.

A welfare coordinator reviews the animal's comfort needs and notes anything the welcome team should watch for at boarding. Small details matter here, from crate fit to feeding reminders. If you are traveling with a pet like Suki, bring the papers in order and keep them easy to reach.

The desk uses the same careful approach for every route. You will be guided through the arrival check, and the team will confirm that the documents match the booking. <<FACT F074>> The staff then continue with the rest of the review so the trip can stay on track.

If your animal needs a health certificate, bring it with the rest of the paperwork. For larger dogs, <<FACT F081>> Keep the original with you unless the desk tells you otherwise, because the review is smoother when everything is clear and ready.

The welcome team then prepares the passenger for boarding and helps with the next steps. If something is missing, they will tell you what needs attention before departure can continue. The service treats each journey as a shared responsibility, so the check is not meant to feel rushed or formal.

Aurelia Skyways aims for dependable companion travel, and the desk is there to make that happen with clear guidance and steady handling. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
